notes:
Background: lightweight ecommerce platform (checkout helpers, order-triage, product Q&A). SMB self-serve sign-up 2 weeks ago. Trialing hosted API on public cloud. Concern: frequent 429s during marketing blasts -> poor user experience.

Key convo snippets:
- CTO (Anya): "we run hourly promo blasts that can spike API calls 5-10x for ~10 minutes. Can't tolerate 429 spikes."
- Product: needs 95th pct latency < 300ms for chat path, throughput target ~100 req/s during normal traffic, burst to 500 req/s for short windows.

Observed behavior from initial test: many 429s; calls retry but front-end shows errors. They reported missing rate-limit headers in some responses and no clear Retry-After guidance. Customer is price-sensitive; wants suggestions that minimize token/unit cost (batching, caching) but avoid user-facing errors.

Tone: pragmatic, wants fast self-serve solution first then upgrade path to dedicated if predictable growth.

requirements_summary: Primary: hosted API on public cloud. Need reliable burst handling for marketing spikes (short 5-15 minute high-QPS windows). Must avoid visible 429 failures; prefer graceful degradation (queued/partial results, soft-fallback to cached answers). SLA expectations loose for SMB but product needs 95th pct latency < 300ms on chat endpoint during normal traffic. Cost sensitivity: low-mid; first goal: avoid expensive always-on dedicated capacity. Wants per-key concurrency controls, clear rate-limit headers, transient burst credits, and docs on exponential backoff semantics.
poc_results: Short POC: simulated promo spike (30m, ramp to 500 req/s). Result: 429s appeared within 90s of ramp, peaking at 12% of requests; 95th pct latency increased from 180ms -> 620ms. No consistent Retry-After header present. Client retried aggressively causing amplifying effect. Customer flagged missing dashboard metrics for per-api-key concurrency and burst usage.
contact_quote: we can accept occasional throttling but not 429s during promos — customers abandon flows, and it's visible on site
suggested_redwood_asks: Enable per-api-key burst bucket for 24-72h POC windows
Ensure rate-limit headers (x-rw-limit, x-rw-remaining, Retry-After) are present on 429s
Share recommended client-side retry/backoff snippet for JS + mobile
Provide short doc on cost tradeoffs: batching, cache prefixes, token-level savings
Offer short-term burst add-on pricing (one-time or credits) for spikes
